Guinsoo's Rageblade

3000 goldFinished item

An on-hit item (on-hit means it triggers every time your attack lands) with attack damage, ability power and attack speed that stacks attack speed, and every third attack applies on-hit effects twice when fully stacked.

Stats

  • 30 Attack Damage
  • 30 Ability Power
  • 25% Attack Speed

What it does

Wrath: Attacks deal 30 bonus magic damage On-Hit.

Seething Strike: Attacks grant 8% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. (stacks 4 times). While fully stacked, every third Attack applies On-Hit effects twice.

When to buy it

Buy it on champions who deal damage with fast basic attacks and other on-hit items.

Good on

Kai'Sa Vayne Kog'Maw Varus

Builds from

Amplifying Tome Recurve Bow Pickaxe
